description: s.393(1) [Table: Sl. No. 6(iii)(c)] of the Income-tax Act 2025 as amended by the Finance Act 2026: 'remuneration or fees or commission by whatever name called, other than those on which tax is deductible under section 392, to a director of a company'. Rate limb (b), '10% of such sum in cases other than (a)'. Form 140 Annexure 2 payment code 1028 - NOT 1027, though both share limb 6(iii).D(b). 50,000 x 10% = 5,000. Hand-computed.
